Performance Impact

The Real Impact of Dust on Solar Performance in Ayodhya

In North India, seasonal weather conditions place heavy demands on exposed photovoltaic panels:

  • April to June (Pre-Monsoon Dust Storms / Aandhi): Intense westerly dry winds deposit thick layers of fine alluvial dust across flat solar glass, reducing power production by 15% to 25% within days.
  • October to November (Harvest & Biomass Smog): Particulate haze and crop residue dust create an oily film that reduces sunlight transmission.
  • December to January (Winter Fog & Dew): Morning condensation traps soot onto glass surfaces, forming an encrusted layer that light rains cannot wash off.

Routine washing every two to three weeks with clean water restores optimal light absorption and protects against localized cell overheating (hotspots) caused by bird droppings.

Maintenance Checklist

  • Wash panels early morning or late evening
  • Never wash hot panels under blazing midday sun
  • Avoid borewell water with heavy mineral scaling
  • Do not step or walk directly on solar panels
  • Check inverter display weekly for fault codes

Our Services

Comprehensive Solar Maintenance & Diagnostic Solutions

From scheduled bi-weekly cleaning to in-depth annual electrical audits, we keep your plant operating at peak efficiency.

  • Professional Module Cleaning

    Manual and soft-water washing using microfiber water-fed brushes. We remove baked-in atmospheric soot, seasonal agricultural dust, and bird droppings without micro-scratching AR-coated glass.

  • Structural & Fastener Audit

    Inspection of all galvanized iron (GI) purlins, rafter joints, and anchor foundation bolts. Fasteners are re-torqued to manufacturer specifications to ensure storm resilience.

  • Electrical Diagnostics & String Testing

    Open circuit voltage (Voc) and operating current (Isc) testing across every DC string. We verify MC4 connector insulation and inspect DCDB/ACDB surge protective devices.

  • Earthing Pit Resistance Measurement

    Verification of earth pit ohmic resistance values using a digital earth tester. We recondition chemical earthing electrodes with moisture-retaining compounds where necessary.

  • Thermal Hotspot & Bypass Diode Check

    Infrared thermal scanning to identify cell micro-cracks, shaded hotspots, or failed bypass diodes that degrade total string energy generation.

  • Inverter Health & Firmware Updates

    Verification of MPPT tracking parameters, grid voltage frequency synchronization, error log analysis, and Wi-Fi data monitoring calibration.

Safety Protocols

Safe Maintenance Practices on Rooftop Terraces

Maintaining a high-voltage electrical power plant on an elevated terrace requires strict safety precautions:

1. Thermal Shock Prevention

During summer in Ayodhya, solar glass can reach temperatures above 65°C. Spraying cold water on baking glass induces intense thermal shock, causing micro-fractures or catastrophic tempered glass shattering. We clean only during early morning or evening hours.

2. High-Voltage DC Hazard Protection

Solar arrays produce high DC voltage as long as sunlight hits them — even when the inverter is switched off. Our technicians utilize insulated tools, verify cable conduit seals, and check for rodent damage or exposed copper conductors.

3. Rooftop Edge Safety

Elevated mounting structures place technicians near parapet perimeters. We observe strict fall-protection procedures to protect personnel and property.

FAQ

Solar Maintenance Frequently Asked Questions

Have a question that isn’t answered here?

Ask on WhatsApp

How much maintenance does rooftop solar need?

Very little. The main task is cleaning dust off the panels with water and a soft brush — more often in the dry, dusty months before the monsoon. Glance at the inverter display regularly and have the wiring, earthing and structure inspected periodically. See solar maintenance.

Does solar still work during cloudy weather?

Yes, but output drops. Heavily overcast monsoon days and foggy winter mornings in Ayodhya can reduce generation noticeably, while clear days from March to May usually produce the most. Annual estimates already account for this seasonal variation.

What happens if my roof has shade?

Shade on even part of a panel can reduce the output of a whole string, so placement matters. We map shade from water tanks, parapets, stair rooms, trees and neighbouring buildings, then position panels to avoid it — sometimes using a raised structure. Heavily shaded roofs may not be worth it, and we will say so.

How long does solar installation take?

For a typical home system, the physical installation usually takes one to three days once materials are on site. The complete process — application, DISCOM feasibility, installation, net meter and inspection — can take a few weeks, depending largely on approval and meter timelines.

Can I contact a solar installer in Ayodhya through WhatsApp?

Yes. Message us on WhatsApp at +91 9580659559. Sending a photo of a recent electricity bill and a few photos of your roof helps us give you a quicker preliminary idea before a site visit.
